scripts.build: echo "Static site - no build process needed" && exit 0
scripts.precheck: npm run lint:js && npm run check:functions
scripts.lint:js: echo '🔍 Checking for console.log...' && ! grep -r 'console\.log' public/js/*.js | grep -v 'analytics.js' | grep -v '//' || echo '⚠️  Found console.log statements'
scripts.check:functions: echo '⚙️  Checking critical functions...' && grep -q 'initProjectFiltering' public/js/script.js && grep -q 'switchLanguage' public/js/translations.js && grep -q 'initHeroConversation' public/js/script.js && echo '✅ All critical functions present' || (echo '❌ Missing critical functions' && exit 1)
scripts.predeploy: npm run precheck && npm run test:smoke
scripts.deploy:safe: npm run predeploy && npm run deploy
